paired_design: Same clean boards, calibration cells and tie RNG per paired bank. Separate corruption streams, independent of source/tie/cell RNG. Adaptive masks may differ between noise arms because histories differ; no future/unqueried values enter selection.
iid_law: Every query independently errs with probability1/20, choosing uniformly among8 other digits. Repeated calibration labels have independent noise.
shared_law: Each board draws one Bernoulli(1/20) event and one uniform derangement of9 digits, sampled by rejection of independent uniform permutations until no fixed points. Draw a derangement even if eventfalse. The SAME event/permutation serves both calibration repeats or all training queries for this board. Training mask is fixed before either current-board draw.
marginal_law_proof: Every digit changes iff shared eventtrue, so marginal error1/20. Uniform derangement symmetry gives conditional wrong digit1/8 and unconditional each wrong digit1/160. A merely nonidentity permutation would not suffice.
theorem_predictions: Shared bijections preserve every pair equality. Calibration repeats agree identically, so iid-based calibration returns the count0 bound below5% and misses nominaleta in32/32 banks. At the same fitted threshold, entire clean/corrupted adaptive trajectories coincide. True-edge equality is always0, hence never crosses pruning boundary.
empirical_primary: Pooled retained extra edge-bank count under shared corruption <=10% of iid pooled count, and zero missing true edges across BOTH arms. Exact finite-bank conjunction supports iff both pass, otherwise falsifies; no independent-edge or universal claim. No confidence interval or outcome filtering.
separation: Corruption invariance and calibration-undercoverage identities are mathematical consequences audited independently. The size of extra-edge reduction is an empirical finite-bank result. This is not a claim that correlation is automatically harder or easier.
learner: Unchanged exposure selector exponential_e,25 queries; repeated-query Clopper-Pearson99.5% bound on1000 indicators, outward1e-6 eta grid; q0=eta/4-9eta^2/64,q1=1/9; first crossing threshold648000; no pruning fallback remains unchanged.
independent_audits: Exhaustive enumeration133496 derangements with16687 mappings for each distinct ordered digit pair. Exact source replay. Independent RNG/rejection/corruption reconstruction, Decimal80 calibration endpoints/predecessors and threshold checks, every history-only mask/noise/logLR/first crossing replay. For shared noise, separate clean state evolves and matches every mask/count/exclusion/first-crossing state on all1110 rows per bank.
budget: <=900 aggregate CPU seconds and180 wall seconds for complete execution including preparation, independent audits and summary, up to8 CPU workers. OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads1; live owned-process CPU/wall monitor terminates only owned subprocesses on exhaustion. No extensions and no GPU work.
stopping_rule: Exactly32 fresh paired source banks x2 arms. Retain all calibration, corruption, structural and fallback outcomes. No new solver cohort.
limitations: Shared uniform derangements preserve relational information; arbitrary correlated noise need not.
IID calibration coverage theorem does not apply under shared repeated-query errors.
Finite-bank pooled structural counts, not independent edge trials or population accuracy.
